title: Change of rings between quasi-coherent algebras: quasi-coherence and affine sections
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal B$ and $\mathcal C$ be sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-modules are quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], let $\varphi:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras, and let $\mathcal P$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-module (through $\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal B$) is quasi-coherent. Let $\mathcal P\otimes_{\mathcal B}\mathcal C$ be the change of rings along $\varphi$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], the sheafification of the presheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal P(W)\otimes_{\mathcal B(W)}\mathcal C(W)$, a sheaf of $\mathcal C$-modules, and let $t_W:\mathcal P(W)\otimes_{\mathcal B(W)}\mathcal C(W)\to(\mathcal P\otimes_{\mathcal B}\mathcal C)(W)$ be the component of the sheafification map. Then the underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-module of $\mathcal P\otimes_{\mathcal B}\mathcal C$ (through $\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$) is quasi-coherent, and for every affine open $W\subseteq Y$ the map $t_W$ is bijective.
